name: Smith Machine Decline Close-Grip Bench Press
steps: Set a decline bench beneath the bar, secure your legs and lie back with the bar over your lower chest.
Draw your shoulders against the pad, take a shoulder-width overhand grip and release the hooks.
Lower the bar slowly to your lower chest while tucking your elbows close to your ribs.
Press the bar up until your arms extend and secure the hooks when finished.
tips: Keep your elbows close to your sides to shift emphasis firmly onto your triceps.
Use a grip narrow enough to recruit your triceps without twisting your wrists awkwardly.
